headline: Egypt Targets Production of 100,000 Electric Vehicles Annually by 2032
summary: Egypt aims to produce up to 100,000 electric vehicles annually by 2032 to decrease import dependence, boost domestic manufacturing, and expand exports.
why: Government industrial strategies targeting the EV sector aim to reshape trade balances and build local automotive supply chains.
